Highlights include FY26 revenue of ₹6,322 Cr, 9x PAT growth, and 34% ROCE.

Black Box Ltd partners with AIONOS to boost AI transformation globally.
The alliance focuses on productivity, cost optimization, and India's GCC ecosystem.

The dividend proposal is subject to shareholder approval at the next meeting.

HDFC Securities reviews Q4 FY26, upgrading Indian Hotels to Buy with Rs 801 target; 14% YoY revenue growth noted.

BlueStone shares drop over 4% with 0.6% equity traded via block deals.

Borosil Renewables' Executive Chairman shared a business update on CNBC Awaaz on June 3, 2026.

Campus Activewear reports a 25.2% increase in PAT and 24.9% rise in PBT for March 2026.

AvenuesAI's subsidiary, Avenues World FZ LLC, received in-principle approval for a Retail Payment Services Category III license from UAE's Central Bank.
This approval aims to strengthen Avenues World FZ LLC's position in UAE's digital payments ecosystem, fostering growth and innovation.

AvenuesAI Ltd's FY26 revenue surged 103% YoY to INR 8,116 cr, PAT grew 58% to INR 332 cr.
The company focuses on AI-driven fintech, asset-light lending via NBFCs, and global ecosystem expansion.

Cello World guides for 10–12% revenue growth and 250 bps EBITDA margin expansion in FY27, driven by steelware, glassware units, and Cello pen integration.
Shares fell 36% YoY, trading at Rs. 386.05 with a market cap of Rs. 8,527.3 crore and a P/E of 25.3 despite healthy cash flows.

Factors include rising competition, import pressure, receivables rationalization, weaker margins, and lower PAT estimates.
Century Plyboards' subsidiary, Century Adhesives, launches resin unit in Andhra Pradesh.
Prabhudas Lilladher issues 'Accumulate' rating on Century Plyboard; CMP is 769.65 as of May 26.
HDFC Standard Life sold 150,000 shares of Cera Sanitaryware at Rs 5,480 each.

Cera Sanitaryware saw an NSE block trade worth Rs. 82.5 crore.
Around 150,112 shares were traded at Rs. 5,497.5 per share.

CIEINDIA Q4 FY26 net sales rose 14.9% YoY to Rs 2,611.95 cr; net profit up 20.8%.
EPS increased to Rs 6.57; shares closed at Rs 457.20, yielding 10.9% in 6 months.

CIE Automotive India acquired 26.09% in Suryadeep GJ3 by subscribing 4.8L shares.
The Rs. 48L investment aims to enable captive solar power for cost optimization.

news.title:
CMS Info CEO Rajiv Kaul clarified his intention to participate in the company's ongoing buyback.
The voluntary clarification ensures transparency and prevents misinterpretation among shareholders.

Buyback period is May 29 to June 4, 2026, with an aggregate consideration of ₹167.9 crore.

Corona Remedies got EU GMP certification for hormone manufacturing facility.

Record date for dividend eligibility set as July 16, 2026; dividend to be paid within 30 days post-AGM.

Crizac Ltd reported FY26 revenue growth of 22.7% to ₹10,422 mn with 15% YoY Q4 growth.
EBITDA rose 31% YoY, PAT increased 41%, and agent network expanded 36% to 5,389 agents.

Crizac reports Q4 consolidated net profit of 750M rupees, up from 500M YoY.
The earnings momentum highlights significant growth for Crizac in Q4.

CSB Bank Ltd's valuation shifts to very attractive due to low P/E and P/BV ratios.
Despite underperforming Sensex, stable fundamentals make CSB Bank appealing for investors.

CSB Bank Ltd's technical momentum turns bearish despite modest weekly gains.
Key indicators and price action suggest investor caution amid market challenges.

Promoter Aditya Kumar Halwasiya acquired 2.6M shares of Cupid Ltd, raising his stake to 33.08%.
Total promoter group holding in Cupid Ltd now stands at 46.01%; acquisition complies with SEBI norms.

Cupid Ltd targets ₹600 Cr revenue, ₹180 Cr net profit by FY27 with 30% margins.
₹150 Cr revenue from Style Baazar to aid in achieving ₹500 Cr midterm run rate.

Datamatics Global Services released Q4FY26 earnings call transcript on May 22, 2026.
Transcript is available on their website under investor relations section.

SBI Life appoints Datamatics to enhance underwriting with AI automation.
Datamatics to use Agentic AI for redefining SBI Life's operations.

Dilip Buildcon targets 75% of profits from infrastructure assets, mining by FY29, reducing EPC reliance.
Company plans ₹2,000 cr equity investment, doubling mining volumes to 60 mn tonnes; debt reduction underway.

Dilip Buildcon targets 75% profits from MDO and InvIT, 25% from EPC by FY29.
FY27 EPC revenue target is ₹10,000 Cr with 12% margins; MDO revenue ₹4,000 Cr by FY29.

Valor Estate Ltd's board meeting on May 29, 2026, to approve audited Q4 and FY26 results.
The meeting aligns with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements, 2015.

The 205-acre land title in Mira Bhayandar is now settled; the company awaits the certified order copy.

Diamond Power Infra commissions 8th MV EHV cable line in Vadodara, adding 150 km capacity.
The Rs 30 crore investment, funded via internal accruals, raises capacity to 1,200 km/month.

Diamond Power Infra starts 8th power cable line in Vadodara, investing ₹30 crore.
The new line aims to boost monthly production capacity by 150 km.

Dynamatic Technologies posted Q4 FY26 net profit of ₹12.56cr, up 117.7% QoQ.
YoY profit declined 21.9%, highlighting struggles with consistent profitability despite revenue growth.

EBITDA grew 15.4%, margins stable at 11.3%; PAT surged 39.4% to Rs.599.8 mn excluding exceptions.

Arun Mehta, ex-SBI Cap Markets chief, becomes Edelweiss ARC CEO for 3 years.
RBI approved his appointment; Edelweiss ARC lacked a full-time CEO for 2 years.

Edelweiss Financial Services launches ₹300 crore NCD issue with yields up to 10%, tenures of 24-120 months.
75% of proceeds will repay borrowings; NCDs rated CRISIL A (Stable) and listed on BSE for liquidity.

Enviro Infra Engineers' revenue rose 7.5% YoY to ₹11,456 Mn in FY26.
Order book grew 242% YoY to ₹68,136 Mn; EBITDA up 3.4%, margins at 24.2%.

The project involves hybrid renewable energy (wind & solar) and will finish by June 2027.
Electrosteel Castings CFO Ashutosh Agarwal resigns from his position.

Despite sequential improvement, the ₹4,886 crore firm faces structural operational challenges.

Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases' core gas revenue rose 9% QoQ in Q4 FY26.
EBITDA margin improved to 40% in Q4; one-offs of ₹46M impacted reported EBITDA.

Motilal Oswal retains Buy rating on Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases.
Target price raised to ₹330 from ₹300, indicating potential upside.

Electronics Mart Q4 saw a 50% profit rise to ₹40 cr, revenue grew 15% YoY to ₹1,913 cr.
Shares gained 9.5%, hitting ₹127 intraday; EBITDA rose 21%, margins expanded to 6.7%.
Electronics Mart announces Q4 earnings, highlighting key financial details.

Entero Healthcare's FY revenue rose 31.5% to INR 6,591 Cr, EBITDA at INR 266 Cr.
MedTech segment surpassed INR 1,000 Cr; FY27 targets 23% revenue growth, 5% EBITDA margin.

Jefferies maintains Buy on Entero Healthcare Solutions, raising TP to ₹1500 citing 23% FY27 organic growth.
Higher tax and depreciation trim FY27 EPS, but 100 bps EBITDA margin expansion supports positive outlook.

EPL Ltd approved merger with Indovida India Pvt Ltd; CCI cleared it on May 26, 2026.
Merger to proceed under Companies Act; detailed CCI order awaited.

EPL's MD & CEO Hemant Bakshi discusses Q4 EBITDA growth outpacing revenue.
Key drivers for EPL's margin expansion were shared in a detailed interview.

Equitas Small Finance Bank targets 1.5% exit ROA by Q4 FY27.
It aims for 1.2% ROA for full FY27, focusing on profitability.

Equitas Small Finance Bank expects 10% of advances from MFI in FY27.
Overall advances are projected to grow over 20% in FY27 via product growth.

Ethos Q4 net profit dropped 3% YoY to ₹22 crore; revenue rose 33% to ₹414 crore.
EBITDA grew 8% YoY to ₹51 crore; margin fell to 12.3% from 15.2%.

Ethos Ltd's board approved audited financial results for FY26 and appointed Munish Gupta as an Executive Director.
Auditor's report confirmed financials with unmodified opinion; results published per SEBI regulations.

Nomura suggests buying Eureka Forbes, setting a target price of ₹600/share.
Q4 FY26 EBITDA beat estimates; new products, price hikes to boost margins.

Eureka Forbes aims to achieve over 2x revenue and 3x EBITDA by FY30.
The company plans strategic health tech expansion to drive this growth.

Fedbank Financial Services Ltd has fully redeemed its commercial paper (CP) under ISIN INE007N14ER9.
The CP, valued at Rs. 150 crore, was redeemed on its maturity date, May 26, 2026.

Fedbank Financial Services confirmed timely interest payment of ₹1.19 crore and partial principal redemption of ₹7.5 crore on NCDs.
The outstanding amount post-redemption is ₹67.5 crore, with TDS of ₹13.3 lakh deducted and deposited as per regulations.

Fiem Industries CEO-Whole Time Director resigns citing personal reasons.
Resignation received on May 19, 2026, with plans for a smooth transition.
Fiem Industries schedules Board meeting on 25 May 2026 to announce quarterly results.

news.title:
Plastic pipe makers like Finolex, Prince Pipes, Astral, Supreme posted strong Q4 FY26 with multi-quarter high volumes, revenues.

Q4 PAT beat estimates with OPM at 25% vs 14.6% YoY; agri at 65% of pipes mix, plumbing share to hit 50% in 5 years.

Gujarat Ambuja Exports' Q4 net profit rose to ₹1.35B from ₹327M YoY.
Q4 revenue increased to ₹14.66B from ₹12.67B YoY.

GHCL Ltd shows bearish momentum with technical indicators signaling increased downside pressure.
The small-cap chemical firm faces market underperformance, raising investor concerns.

GHCL Ltd fell 6.1%, closing at ₹445.05, underperforming Sensex's 0.5% gain.

Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers marks 50 years, profitable except FY14-15.
Q4 chemicals strong; FY26 PAT up 35% YoY at INR 797 crore; dividend INR 210.

Godrej Agrovet's Q4 FY26 revenue grew 9% to INR 2,333 cr; PBT rose 16.8% to INR 87 cr.

FY26 PBT (excl. non-recurring) rises 17% to Rs. 569 cr; Oil Palm, Animal Nutrition excel.

Greaves Cotton Ltd to invest Rs. 50 Cr in subsidiary Greaves Finance for growth.

India Glycols Ltd updates on NCLT hearing regarding its Scheme of Arrangement.

Le Travenues acquires 54.7% stake in Brevistay for ₹65.7 crore.

ixigo to acquire 54.66% stake in Brevistay for ₹65.7 Cr.

Jai Balaji Industries highlighted in NDTV Profit's pre-open market roundup.

Jamna Auto Industries' board to meet on May 29, 2026, to approve FY26 results.

ASM curbs limit trading to once a week with a 5% price band, slowing price discovery and affecting investor exits.

Axis Bank accuses Reliance Home Finance of forgery in the alleged fraud case.

Alleged fraud involves Rs 27,337 crore; two Reliance Communications executives are in judicial custody.

Sadbhav Engineering's board to meet on May 30, 2026, to review Q4 and FY26 results.
Trading window remains closed from April 1, 2026, reopening 48 hours post-results declaration.

The company focuses on strategic expansion to achieve this milestone.

Financial trend score improved from 19 to 12, indicating better profitability.

Net profit dropped 82% to Rs 0.61 crore; shares yielded 35.5% returns in 6 months.

Refund of ₹32.6 lakh paid to the company; communication received on June 4, 2026.

Sambhaav Media's FY26 results show total income of 4004.03L, PBT at 150.71L.
Net profit at 44.4L; continuing operations profit at 109.63L. Management changes announced.

Board under CIRP; results to be uploaded on the company website post May 25, 2026.

Sanwaria Consumer Ltd schedules board meeting on May 25, 2026, to approve audited results.

Sayaji Industries MD Priyam B. Mehta foresees FY26 recovery with annual profits.

Operations began on June 1, 2026, marking a significant milestone in the company's growth.

Sheetal Cool Products Q4 FY26 net profit rose 72.4% YoY to ₹8.17 cr.
Despite strong results, seasonal volatility and growth challenges remain.

The investment aims to expand its presence in digital financial services, subject to RBI approval.

FY24 turnover was Rs. 843.01L with a net loss of Rs. 712.8L amid staff shortages.

SecUR Credentials Ltd board meeting set for Apr 29, 2026 to review financial results.
Results include unaudited and audited standalone financials for multiple periods ending Mar 31, 2025.

Company paid Rs. 2 crore; promoter paid Rs. 1.5 crore by March 27, 2026.

SAT partially allows Securekloud's appeal; Rs.3.83 crore recovery from promoter set aside.
SEBI imposed Rs.4 crore penalty; Rs.2 crore paid. Appeals dismissed on other SEBI order portions.

SAT stayed SEBI's order against Setco Automotive promoters, imposed on May 8, 2026.
SEBI's order involved a ₹208.8 Cr penalty, market ban, citing FY19-22 fund diversion.

Tarmat Ltd's board meeting on May 30, 2026, will review Q4 and FY26 audited financials.

Tree House Education's board meeting on May 15, 2026, to approve FY 2026 financial results.

Univa Foods Ltd's board meeting on 26th May 2026 to review audited standalone financial results.

Univa Foods Ltd to hold board meeting on 5th Feb 2026.
